evidence.title: BUILD-001: artifact digests made checkout-line-ending independent
evidence.description: file_sha256 previously hashed raw working-tree bytes, so every digest depended on the checkout's line endings. Hashing now normalizes CRLF to LF for non-binary files (binary files, detected by NUL, are hashed verbatim), and `size` records the normalized length so size and digest always agree. .gitattributes (* text eol=lf) is now the single source of line-ending truth. All 279 recorded digests were recomputed once via --refresh-digests.

evidence.finding: The provenance gate is now honest across platforms: CI can verify a clean checkout instead of rewriting it.
